form.title: Create agency
form.description: The first admin receives an invitation by email.
form.name: Agency name

detail.suspendDescription: Its users see "Workspace suspended" at sign-in and background jobs are skipped. Data is not touched.

budget.title: Monthly AI budget

level.over: Budget used: AI drafting is paused

budget.label: Limit in USD (leave empty for no limit)

support.title: Support access
support.intro: You cannot see this agency's data unless its admin approves a request. Access is read-only, limited to the hours you ask for and every page you open is logged.
support.reason: Why do you need to look?
support.reasonHint: The agency admin reads this before deciding.
support.reasonError: Say why, in at least 10 characters.
support.requested: Request sent to the agency admins.
support.requestFailed: The request could not be sent. You may already have an open one.

deletion.title: Delete this agency
deletion.intro: At contract end an owner or admin asks for the agency's data to be deleted, and a different owner or admin approves. Both type the agency's URL name. Everything is removed for good: all records, files and the agency itself. A record of the deletion stays here. Its admins can download their data first (Settings, Data export).
deletion.waitingForSecond: You asked for this deletion. A different owner or admin has to approve it.
deletion.running: Deleting. {rows} rows removed so far. This page updates by itself.
deletion.runFailed: The deletion stopped with an error. Nothing more is removed until someone asks again; what was already removed stays removed.
deletion.failed: This did not work. Check the name you typed, and that you are not the person who asked.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Switch features on or off for this agency. Each change is logged here and in the agency's activity log.

billing.title: Plan and billing
billing.assigned: The agency is on the plan.
billing.failed: This did not work. Billing may be unreachable.
billing.changeInBilling: This agency already has a subscription on another plan. Change it in Billing Server.
billing.plansUnavailable: The plan list could not be loaded.

errors.slugTaken: This URL name is already taken.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.empty: No AI usage in this period.

form.title: Invite an administrator
form.description: They sign in with the invited email address and open the link you send them. The link works once.

link.title: Send this link
link.description: Copy it now and send it to {email}. It is shown only once and works once.

errors.lastOwner: The platform needs at least one owner.
errors.alreadyAdmin: This person is already an administrator.
errors.alreadyPending: This person already has a pending invitation.

accept.title: Join the platform administrators
accept.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an owner for a new one.
accept.wrongEmail: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with the invited address.
accept.failed: This invitation could not be accepted: {reason}

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Platform-wide settings. Only an owner can change them.
settings.none: No key is set. The AI features cannot run until one is added.
settings.inUse: A key is in use ({source}), ending in {last4}.
settings.unreadable: A key is stored but cannot be read (the server's encryption key changed). Enter it again.
settings.apiKeyHint: Starts with sk-ant-. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the key.
settings.error: Could not do that. Try again.

check.ok: The key works and has credit.
check.invalid_key: Anthropic did not accept this key.
check.no_credit: The key is valid but the account has no credit left.
check.unreachable: Could not reach Anthropic. Try again.

deletions.title: Deleted agencies
deletions.intro: The permanent record of agencies deleted at contract end. It holds no agency content.

health.title: System health
health.intro: Job queues, mail that did not go out, and AI errors and refusals, per agency. Counts and ids only: nothing a candidate or client wrote is shown here.
health.generated: Updated {when}. The page refreshes by itself.

failed.title: Latest failed jobs
failed.intro: Use the id to find the run in the logs.
failed.empty: No failed jobs in this period.

routing.title: AI routing and prompt versions
routing.intro: Which model and effort each AI capability uses, and the version of its prompt. These live in the code: changing one is a deploy that needs a passing evaluation run first (model change control), so this table is read only.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Switched for one agency at a time on that agency's page. Every flag is checked by the feature it names.

about.portals: Hiring manager and candidate portals: invitations, shares and the portal pages.
about.email_sending: Sending email from the product. Off keeps copy and mark as sent working.

defaults.title: New agency defaults
defaults.intro: A new agency is created with these settings. Agencies that already exist keep their own, and each agency's admin can change theirs. Saved changes are logged.
